notes:
Account snapshot: strong need for cross-lingual RAG across 10+ languages (en, fr, de, es, it, nl, pt, sv, pl, ru). Primary data: product manuals, support tickets, contracts (sensitive).

Key constraints / asks: short tail latency <= 120ms for priors (query + 1 rerank pass), p50 token latency target 60ms for hosted fallback; cost target ~= $0.003/query after batching for standard queries. Indexing scale: ~10M docs now, plan to grow to 80M in 12 months. Must support per-language recall/precision tuning and per-language vector normalization.

Preferred architecture: embeddings store in dedicated VPC with hot shard replicas in EU region; reranking step run on dedicated GPUs; prefer deterministic reranker (cross-encoder) for top-50 then light re-ranker for top-5. Interested in Redwood's auto-batching + Optimize recommendations to reduce per-token cost.

Security/compliance: legal insists on data residency in EU, SSO/SAML integration mandatory, audit logs for inference calls, optional KMS/HSM for key management.

What they said: "We need consistent recall across languages — English is easy, Spanish and Polish are where we lose 15-20% of relevance today." — Head of Search (call 2026-01-15).

Internal sentiment: engineering likes Redwood runtime performance claims; ML team skeptical about cross-lingual reranker latency; infra worried about on-prem GPU availability and support SLA.

Artifacts: see drive scope doc and security FAQ (links below). Gmail thread contains legal's initial redlines. Jira tickets created for pre-POC infra checklist.
